rules.quote: **Never hardcode tactic/technique tables**
rules.rule: Never hardcode ATT&CK tactic or technique tables; derive them from the pinned dataset instead.

rules.quote: written ONLY by `tools/attack_data.py`
rules.rule: Write the pinned dataset file attack/enterprise-attack.json only via tools/attack_data.py, never by any other means.

rules.quote: the store is never rewritten when the pin moves
rules.rule: Never rewrite the store when the ATT&CK pin moves.

rules.quote: never a migration shim
rules.rule: Do not treat prose-based technique extraction as a migration shim; keep it as a permanent code path.

rules.quote: An audit may lift a single legacy entry via an `improvement` record, never the store.
rules.rule: When auditing, lift a single legacy entry only via an improvement record, never by rewriting the store.

rules.quote: do not map one
rules.rule: When no source states the access vector, do not map a technique for it.

rules.quote: the entry is describing too little to publish
rules.rule: If the honest technique mapping would be empty, do not publish the entry.

rules.quote: For routine in-repo fixes (site/build.py, tools, prompt edits with version bump, docs), go end-to-end: sync main → stage specifics → commit → second sync → push with retry → poll auto-merge → poll deploy-site → live URL probe.
rules.rule: For routine in-repo fixes, carry the full publishing chain end-to-end (sync main, stage, commit, second sync, push with retry, poll auto-merge, poll deploy-site, probe the live URL) without stopping to ask.

rules.quote: Never stop at "ready to commit/push" and ask.
rules.rule: Never stop at a "ready to commit/push" state to ask the user for permission before committing or pushing a routine in-repo fix.

rules.quote: Include `.claude/memory/` in the staged list whenever memory was touched.
rules.rule: Whenever memory files were modified, include `.claude/memory/` in the staged files.

rules.quote: Still pause for: destructive operations (force-push, branch/state-file deletion)
rules.rule: Pause and ask before performing destructive operations such as force-push or deleting branches or state files.

rules.quote: shared-infrastructure changes (workflows, branch protection, CNAME)
rules.rule: Pause and ask before making shared-infrastructure changes such as editing workflows, branch protection, or CNAME.

rules.quote: editorial-policy changes without a clear request
rules.rule: Pause and ask before making editorial-policy changes unless there is a clear request for them.

rules.quote: **do not remove**
rules.rule: Do not remove the `.claude/settings.json` `permissions.defaultMode: "bypassPermissions"` setting or its memory-path allowlist.

rules.quote: if a memory write ever prompts, widen the glob
rules.rule: If a memory write triggers a permission prompt, widen the allowlist glob in `.claude/settings.json` rather than accepting the prompt.

rules.quote: Prefer `Write`/`Edit` tools for memory files.
rules.rule: Prefer the `Write` and `Edit` tools when modifying memory files.

rules.quote: memory not committed to git did not happen.
rules.rule: Commit memory changes to git; memory that is not committed to git is treated as not saved, since the container is destroyed after every run.

rules.quote: `prompts/CHANGELOG.md` is the ONLY place that records when a behaviour changed.
rules.rule: Record every change in behavior only in prompts/CHANGELOG.md, never in other files.

rules.quote: Do NOT write "(v2.53)", "NEW in v2.66", "removed in v2.64" or similar into prompts, agent definitions, CLAUDE.md, docs, config comments, or tool output strings
rules.rule: Do not write version-history annotations (e.g., "(v2.53)", "NEW in v2.66", "removed in v2.64") into prompts, agent definitions, CLAUDE.md, docs, config comments, or tool output strings.

rules.quote: put the history in the CHANGELOG entry and state the rule timelessly in the file itself.
rules.rule: Put version history in the CHANGELOG entry and state rules in the file itself without version framing.

rules.quote: keep any operational rationale inline (e.g. dated incident references like the 2026-05-15 fabrication trace) — only the version framing is banned.
rules.rule: When editing a rule, keep operational rationale such as dated incident references inline; only remove version framing.

rules.quote: Every entry carries exactly one rating.
rules.rule: Every entry must carry exactly one rating.

rules.quote: Non-triage kinds: NATO Admiralty `classification: {reliability, credibility}`.
rules.rule: For non-triage entry kinds, include the NATO Admiralty `classification: {reliability, credibility}` block.

rules.quote: Triage kinds carry `org_triage` INSTEAD only while `config/org-profile.yaml` configures a triage scheme
rules.rule: For triage entry kinds, carry `org_triage` instead of the Admiralty block only while `config/org-profile.yaml` configures a triage scheme.

rules.quote: this deployment configures none, so vulnerability entries carry the Admiralty block too
rules.rule: When no triage scheme is configured, include the Admiralty block on vulnerability entries.

rules.quote: never hand-edit the rendered blocks
rules.rule: Never hand-edit the rule blocks rendered from config by `compose_prompts.py`.

rules.quote: A same-day press write-up of one lab report is NOT a second source.
rules.rule: Do not count a same-day press write-up of a single lab report as a second source.

rules.quote: open the second source and ask what it observed itself
rules.rule: When assessing independence, open the second source and check what it observed itself rather than counting sources.

rules.quote: the entry is `single-source`, credibility 2
rules.rule: If every fact in an entry traces back to the first source, mark the entry `single-source` with credibility 2.

rules.quote: still cite the write-up, just don't count it
rules.rule: Still cite a same-day press write-up that is not counted as a second source.

rules.quote: Genuine second sources perform their own determination
rules.rule: Count a second source as genuine only if it performs its own determination.

rules.quote: a KEV listing over a vendor advisory
rules.rule: Treat a KEV listing as a genuine second source relative to a vendor advisory.

rules.quote: **Defensive role framing** at the top of the spawn message
rules.rule: Put defensive role framing at the top of a sub-agent spawn message.

rules.quote: Reframing the role is legitimate; hiding what the work is is not.
rules.rule: Do not hide what the work is when framing a sub-agent spawn; reframing the agent's role is acceptable.

rules.quote: Point at the coverage file instead of enumerating covered breach/actor names inline
rules.rule: When spawning a sub-agent, point it at the coverage file instead of listing covered breach or actor names inline.

rules.quote: **Checkpoint findings YAML every 3–4 items**
rules.rule: Checkpoint the findings YAML every 3–4 items during a sub-agent spawn.

rules.quote: record spawn terminations per fire
rules.rule: Record spawn terminations for each classifier fire.

rules.quote: Retry once
rules.rule: When a spawn is terminated by the classifier, retry it once.

rules.quote: re-frame (framing + no quoted exploit prose + checkpointing)
rules.rule: If the retry is also tripped, re-frame the spawn using defensive framing, no quoted exploit prose, and checkpointing.

rules.quote: record a failed spawn
rules.rule: If the re-framed spawn also fails, record it as a failed spawn.

rules.quote: set `verification.confirmation_waived` only if it was the confirmation pass
rules.rule: Set verification.confirmation_waived only when the failed spawn was the confirmation pass.

rules.quote: A failed spawn never counts as CLEAN.
rules.rule: Never count a failed spawn as CLEAN.

rules.quote: Never block the run
rules.rule: Never block the run because a spawn failed.

rules.quote: Report a trip as a classifier trip with retry count
rules.rule: Report a classifier trip as a classifier trip, including the retry count.

rules.quote: never as "the mechanism failed"
rules.rule: Never report a classifier trip as "the mechanism failed".

rules.quote: record the category with the request id when the harness shows it
rules.rule: On 5.5 models, when a decline occurs, record the refusal category along with the request id when the harness shows it.

rules.quote: Wait for the notification while the agent is still writing
rules.rule: Wait for the harness notification while a sub-agent is still writing instead of declaring it dead.

rules.quote: stall = 60 min with no write under `work/<run-id>/` and no notification
rules.rule: Treat a spawn as stalled only after 60 minutes with no write under work/<run-id>/ and no notification.

rules.quote: check that a recovery spawn can even advance the gate it exists to protect before starting it
rules.rule: Before starting a recovery spawn, check that it can advance the gate it exists to protect.

rules.quote: Cite once per paragraph when the paragraph rests on one source
rules.rule: When a paragraph rests on one source, cite that source only once in the paragraph.

rules.quote: measure with the gate's own method
rules.rule: Measure the main-analysis word count with the gate's own method (strip link markup with the MD_LINK_TEXT_RE substitution, then collapse whitespace).

rules.quote: draft the replacement in a scratch file and count before applying it
rules.rule: When replacing a changelog entry near the word bound, draft the replacement in a scratch file and count its words before applying it.

rules.quote: must cut as many words as it adds
rules.rule: When rewriting a changelog entry already at 548 words, cut as many words as the rewrite adds.

rules.quote: Re-point a citation to the page that carries the fact.
rules.rule: Cite the page that actually carries a given fact, not a related page.

rules.quote: cite the table's URL for that row, not the entry's primary
rules.rule: When a deep read returns a claim table, cite the table's URL for that row rather than the entry's primary URL.

rules.quote: Give each deep-read spawn its own `work/<run-id>/<tag>/` scratch directory.
rules.rule: Give each deep-read spawn its own work/<run-id>/<tag>/ scratch directory.

rules.quote: restore it
rules.rule: When an update drops detail that the summary and actions[] still claim, restore that detail.

rules.quote: never leave the summary asserting what the body no longer says
rules.rule: Never leave the summary asserting detail that the body no longer contains.

rules.quote: keep the action on the entry that covers both cases
rules.rule: When two entries in the window carry the same action text, keep the action only on the entry that covers both cases.

rules.quote: Read `affected`/`fixed`/patch-timing from **structured** fields, never the human-readable summary
rules.rule: Read affected, fixed, and patch-timing facts from structured fields in vulnerability records, never from the human-readable summary.

rules.quote: `vulnerabilities[].product_status.{known_affected, fixed, known_not_affected, under_investigation}`
rules.rule: For CSAF records, determine affected and fixed status from the vulnerabilities[].product_status fields (known_affected, fixed, known_not_affected, under_investigation).

rules.quote: never conclude "no fix" without checking `remediations`
rules.rule: Never conclude that no fix exists for a CSAF vulnerability without checking its remediations[] array.

rules.quote: `remediations[].category == vendor_fix`
rules.rule: Identify the real patch in CSAF records as the remediations[] entry whose category is vendor_fix.

rules.quote: the row's `fix_state` is the verdict
rules.rule: For Red Hat package_state[] rows, use the row's fix_state field as the verdict on whether the product is affected.

rules.quote: **In every format the enumeration is the scope of assessment and a sibling field is the verdict — transcribe the verdict.**
rules.rule: Transcribe the verdict field, not mere membership in an enumerated list, when recording a vulnerability's status.

rules.quote: spot-check outliers
rules.rule: When a discloser's 'CNA score' value looks like an outlier, spot-check it against the CNA's own containers.cna.metrics.

rules.quote: `cves[].cvss` carries the **BASE** score.
rules.rule: Store the CVSS BASE score in cves[].cvss.

rules.quote: check the linked vector for `E:`/`RL:`/`RC:` before calling two scores contradictory
rules.rule: Before calling two CVSS scores contradictory, check the linked vector for E:, RL:, or RC: metrics, since a displayed score may be temporal.

rules.quote: read every element of `cna.metrics`
rules.rule: Read every element of the CNA's cna.metrics array, not just the first.

rules.quote: Never rank scores across CVSS versions.
rules.rule: Never rank CVSS scores across different CVSS versions.

rules.quote: the number goes in `cves[].cvss`
rules.rule: When multiple legitimate CVSS figures exist, put the chosen number in cves[].cvss.

rules.quote: the reconciliation (which body, which scale) in `sourcing_note`
rules.rule: When multiple legitimate CVSS figures exist, record the reconciliation (which body and which scale) in sourcing_note.

rules.quote: OSV 404s on ecosystem-less products (Joomla extensions, firmware) are not unreachability
rules.rule: Do not treat an OSV 404 for an ecosystem-less product (such as a Joomla extension or firmware) as the CVE being unreachable.

rules.quote: `cves[].epss` is the FIRST.org EPSS **probability**, a quoted decimal in `[0, 1]`
rules.rule: Store cves[].epss as the FIRST.org EPSS probability, a decimal in [0, 1].

rules.quote: It is NOT the percentile and NOT a percentage.
rules.rule: Never store an EPSS percentile or percentage in cves[].epss.

rules.quote: Divide an EUVD figure by 100 before it enters the field
rules.rule: Divide an EUVD EPSS figure by 100 before storing it in the EPSS field.

rules.quote: never paste a provenance suffix (`"0.27 (EUVD)"`) into a numeric field
rules.rule: Never put a provenance suffix such as '(EUVD)' into a numeric field.

rules.quote: Take the API's `epss` field, never its `percentile` field.
rules.rule: Take the EPSS value from the API's epss field, never from its percentile field.

rules.quote: A correction converts the units and preserves the entry's own as-of value
rules.rule: When correcting an EPSS entry, convert its units and preserve the entry's own as-of value.

rules.quote: it does not silently substitute today's number
rules.rule: Do not silently replace an EPSS entry's value with today's number when correcting it.

rules.quote: keep both in sync
rules.rule: Keep the shipped config/branding.yaml and the loader DEFAULTS in sync so the built site stays byte-identical.

rules.quote: the config list is the complete set (empty = none)
rules.rule: Treat the config list for feeds.sector_slices and trends.cohorts as the complete set, and treat an empty list as no entries.

rules.quote: Never reintroduce site-identity literals in `site/build.py`
rules.rule: Never put site-identity literals in site/build.py.

rules.quote: lens phrases in prompt prose outside ORG-PROFILE blocks
rules.rule: Never put lens phrases in prompt prose outside ORG-PROFILE blocks.

rules.quote: write "the profiled constituency (§ Organization profile)"
rules.rule: Where a lens phrase would otherwise appear in prompt prose outside ORG-PROFILE blocks, write "the profiled constituency (§ Organization profile)" instead.

rules.quote: Never write a concrete organization's name, estate, or affiliation into config, README, prompts, or memory
rules.rule: Never write a concrete organization's name, estate, or affiliation into config, README, prompts, or memory.

rules.quote: A lens change is a config edit + `compose_prompts.py --write`
rules.rule: Make a lens change by editing the config and running tools/compose_prompts.py --write.

rules.quote: never a code or prompt edit
rules.rule: Never make a lens change by editing code or prompts.

rules.quote: For byte-diff comparisons of build changes, build both sides with `PYTHONHASHSEED=0`
rules.rule: For byte-diff comparisons of build changes, build both sides with PYTHONHASHSEED=0.

rules.quote: Mechanical habit, every candidate CVE set before composing:
rules.rule: Before composing an entry, check every candidate CVE against the store-wide CVE index (state-summary.json cves ids), not only the 14-day prior_coverage read.

rules.quote: any hit ⇒ grep -rl "<CVE>" entries/, read the entry, decide update-vs-drop
rules.rule: When a candidate CVE hits the store-wide index, grep entries/ for that CVE, read the covered entry, and decide whether to record an update or drop the candidate.

rules.quote: **Read the covered entry's BODY, not just its `cves[].status`**
rules.rule: When evaluating a covered CVE, read the covered entry's body text, not only its cves[].status field.

rules.quote: = `config/branding.yaml` only
rules.rule: Limit branding changes to config/branding.yaml.

rules.quote: Fonts stay system-stack — no external webfont
rules.rule: Keep fonts on the system stack and never load an external webfont.

rules.quote: border-not-shadow
rules.rule: Separate elements with borders, not shadows.

rules.quote: small radii
rules.rule: Use small border radii.

rules.quote: no emoji
rules.rule: Never use emoji in the site.

rules.quote: no IOCs
rules.rule: Never include IOCs on the site.

rules.quote: one crimson accent
rules.rule: Use a single crimson accent colour.

rules.quote: mono = every machine fact
rules.rule: Render every machine fact in the monospace font.

rules.quote: dark-first analyst console
rules.rule: Design the interface dark-first.

rules.quote: Never re-enable `"dlig"`
rules.rule: Never re-enable "dlig" in heading font-feature-settings.

rules.quote: Keep `"kern","liga"`
rules.rule: Keep "kern","liga" in heading font-feature-settings.

rules.quote: need a `:not(.b)` guard
rules.rule: Add a :not(.b) guard to inline-token prose rules that share a class with a badge.

rules.quote: the running ISO week is partial and never compared
rules.rule: Never include the running (partial) ISO week in trends comparisons.

rules.quote: deltas = latest complete week vs prior
rules.rule: Compute trend deltas as the latest complete week compared with the prior week.

rules.quote: Verification flags render neutral
rules.rule: Render verification flags in a neutral colour.

rules.quote: red is reserved for priority/exploited
rules.rule: Use red only for priority or exploited indicators.

rules.quote: never re-hardcode doctrine
rules.rule: Never hardcode classification doctrine; take classification badges and scheme text from config via _load_classification_scheme().

rules.quote: re-check them after any
rules.rule: After any site/build.py renderer edit, re-check the document contract invariants.

rules.quote: Exactly one `<h1>`
rules.rule: Emit exactly one <h1> per page, except redirect stubs and meta-refresh pages.

rules.quote: no skipped levels
rules.rule: Never skip heading levels on a page.

rules.quote: Embedded markdown never keeps its own level
rules.rule: Never let embedded markdown keep its own heading level; pin it with render_markdown(..., heading_base=N).

rules.quote: Run notes pass `head_level`
rules.rule: Pass head_level when rendering run notes.

rules.quote: entry bodies pin to h3
rules.rule: Pin entry bodies to h3.

rules.quote: class="sect">`, not divs.
rules.rule: Render day-brief section headers as <h2 class="sect">, not divs.

rules.quote: Ids are unique per page and every `#anchor` resolves.
rules.rule: Keep ids unique within each page and make every #anchor resolve.

rules.quote: Heading anchors take `anchor_prefix` (run id)
rules.rule: Give heading anchors the run id as anchor_prefix.

rules.quote: `#update-<at>` is emitted only on the entry permalink
rules.rule: Emit #update-<at> anchors only on the entry permalink.

rules.quote: `anchor=False` everywhere else
rules.rule: Pass anchor=False everywhere except the entry permalink.

rules.quote: finding anchors use the entry id, not the slug
rules.rule: Build finding anchors from the entry id, not the slug.

rules.quote: gives the bare `#T…` to the first occurrence
rules.rule: Give the bare #T… anchor only to the first occurrence of an ATT&CK technique.

rules.quote: namespaces tactic repeats
rules.rule: Namespace repeated tactic anchors.

rules.quote: is a link only when its directory row exists.
rules.rule: Make a matrix cell a link only when its directory row exists.

rules.quote: AA contrast in BOTH themes, measured with alpha compositing
rules.rule: Measure contrast ratios against AA in both themes, with alpha compositing applied.

rules.quote: tints must be composited before the ratio means anything
rules.rule: Composite translucent tints before computing a contrast ratio.

rules.quote: it has to clear 4.5:1 on
rules.rule: Make --text-muted clear 4.5:1 on --bg, --bg-elev, --bg-elev-2 and --kbd-bg.

rules.quote: Never de-emphasise with `opacity`
rules.rule: Never de-emphasise text with opacity.

rules.quote: use `--text-muted`
rules.rule: Use --text-muted to de-emphasise text instead of opacity.

rules.quote: All metadata lives in the rail, labelled.
rules.rule: Put all entry metadata in the labelled rail.

rules.quote: The run-dashboard link belongs in Record, never under the title
rules.rule: Place the run-dashboard link in the Record section of the rail, never under the title.

rules.quote: Every table row is a `.frow`
rules.rule: Make every rail table row a .frow with __l label and __v value parts.

rules.quote: The rail never scrolls on its own
rules.rule: Never give the entry rail its own scrollbar.

rules.quote: is never sticky
rules.rule: Never make the entry rail sticky.

rules.quote: carries published + updated
rules.rule: Limit the stamps under the entry title to published and updated.

rules.quote: the updated stamp deep-links to the newest `#update-<at>`
rules.rule: Make the updated stamp deep-link to the newest #update-<at> anchor.

rules.quote: suppressed when it merely restates the title
rules.rule: Suppress the entry headline when it merely restates the title.

rules.quote: The stored `summary` is never repeated here
rules.rule: Never repeat the stored summary on the entry permalink header.

rules.quote: `margin-bottom: 34px`
rules.rule: Give .ehead margin-bottom: 34px rather than placing the margin on .immediate-action.

rules.quote: BOTH columns zero their first child
rules.rule: Zero the first child of both entry columns so their tops align.

rules.quote: live on `body.entry-detail` INSIDE the >=1100px query
rules.rule: Define --entry-col, --entry-rail and --entry-gap on body.entry-detail inside the >=1100px media query.

rules.quote: borrow `--entry-col` (fallback 100%)
rules.rule: Make .elede and .emeta use --entry-col, falling back to 100%.

rules.quote: Body order is actionable-first
rules.rule: Order entry body sections actionable-first.

rules.quote: every one an `.esec` with an `h2.esec-h`
rules.rule: Render every entry body section as an .esec containing an h2.esec-h.

rules.quote: A quote appears once.
rules.rule: Show each evidence quote only once on an entry page.

rules.quote: The immediate-action callout carries neither the first evidence quote
rules.rule: Keep the first evidence quote out of the immediate-action callout.

rules.quote: nor a link to the page it is already on
rules.rule: Keep a link to the current page out of the immediate-action callout.

rules.quote: No in-body ATT&CK section
rules.rule: Do not render an ATT&CK section in the entry body.

rules.quote: the name needs its own `.echip-t` span with `min-width: 0`
rules.rule: Wrap an entity chip's name in its own .echip-t span with min-width: 0.

rules.quote: `.echip` needs `max-width: 100%`
rules.rule: Give .echip max-width: 100%.

rules.quote: Affected-product chips link to the product entity
rules.rule: Link affected-product chips to the product entity.

rules.quote: minus the page's own product
rules.rule: Exclude the page's own product from the entity page's pivot row.

rules.quote: the permalink passes False
rules.rule: Pass with_provenance=False when rendering the entry permalink update blocks.

rules.quote: appear only in the Revision-history panel
rules.rule: Show the run link and raw changed-field names only in the Revision-history panel.

rules.quote: Day pages and feeds keep them
rules.rule: Keep the run link and raw changed-field names on day pages and feeds.

rules.quote: `.erail .erail-h` needs two classes
rules.rule: Give .erail .erail-h both of its classes so .view h2 does not override it.

rules.quote: needs `overflow-x: clip`, never `hidden`, on html/body.
rules.rule: Set overflow-x: clip on html and body for sticky headers; never use hidden.

rules.quote: Header is sticky at >=861px only
rules.rule: Make the header sticky only at widths of 861px and above.

rules.quote: anchors clear it via `html { scroll-padding-top:
rules.rule: Use html scroll-padding-top to keep anchors clear of the sticky header.

rules.quote: One gutter token `--gutter` (14/18/26px) pads topbar, subnav, AI bar, mobile seg, main and footer
rules.rule: Pad topbar, subnav, AI bar, mobile seg, main and footer with the --gutter token.

rules.quote: `.brand-mark svg` must be sized in CSS (22px)
rules.rule: Size the .brand-mark svg in CSS.

rules.quote: theme.js loads WITHOUT `defer`
rules.rule: Load theme.js without defer.

rules.quote: The AI bar ships visible in the HTML (no `hidden`)
rules.rule: Ship the AI bar visible in the HTML without the hidden attribute.

rules.quote: CSS hides it under `:root[data-ai-ack]`
rules.rule: Hide the AI bar via CSS under :root[data-ai-ack].

rules.quote: Search modal is a real dialog
rules.rule: Implement the search modal as a real dialog.

rules.quote: focus trap
rules.rule: Trap focus inside the search modal.

rules.quote: scroll lock
rules.rule: Lock page scroll while the search modal is open.

rules.quote: focus returns to the opener
rules.rule: Return focus to the opener element when the search modal closes.

rules.quote: visible close button
rules.rule: Give the search modal a visible close button.

rules.quote: results list is static inside the panel
rules.rule: Keep the search results list static inside the panel.

rules.quote: never regex over already-escaped HTML
rules.rule: Never run regex over already-escaped HTML in Search.highlight; highlight in one pass over raw text.

rules.quote: carries a search icon next to the hamburger
rules.rule: Place a search icon next to the hamburger in the phone topbar.

rules.quote: the drawer closes on Escape / outside tap / opening search
rules.rule: Close the phone drawer on Escape, outside tap, or when opening search.

rules.quote: List filter chips are `<button aria-pressed>`, never spans
rules.rule: Render list filter chips as <button aria-pressed>, never spans.

rules.quote: every filtered list shows a `.filter-empty` line when nothing matches
rules.rule: Show a .filter-empty line in every filtered list when nothing matches.

rules.quote: Day page filters also hide TL;DR lines / alarm rows / action items via `data-entry-id`
rules.rule: Make day page filters hide TL;DR lines, alarm rows and action items via data-entry-id.

rules.quote: update section counts
rules.rule: Show update section counts such as "1 of 2 items".

rules.quote: chips of emptied sections
rules.rule: Hide jump chips for sections emptied by filtering.

rules.quote: a closed filter panel is `visibility: hidden`
rules.rule: Set a closed filter panel to visibility: hidden so it leaves the tab order.

rules.quote: CVE links point at `entities/<CVE>/`
rules.rule: Point CVE links at entities/<CVE>/ rather than the /cves/<id>/ stub.

rules.quote: the graph's `--g-*` tokens drive the list label dot
rules.rule: Drive the list label dot and type donut colours from the graph --g-* tokens.

rules.quote: are handled by the registry's curated `ambiguous_labels` field
rules.rule: Handle common-word entity names through the registry's ambiguous_labels field.

rules.quote: Do not reintroduce a frequency guard in build.py.
rules.rule: Do not reintroduce a frequency guard in build.py for entity name matching.

rules.quote: Entry rail CVEs collapse past 6
rules.rule: Collapse entry rail CVEs past six.

rules.quote: exploited/KEV keep cards
rules.rule: Keep card display for exploited and KEV CVEs in the entry rail.

rules.quote: the rest are one-line rows in a `<details>`
rules.rule: Show the remaining entry rail CVEs as one-line rows inside a details element.

rules.quote: CVE card facts use a label/value grid.
rules.rule: Lay out CVE card facts as a label/value grid.

rules.quote: wrap their charts in `details.kb-stats[data-fold-on-phone]`
rules.rule: Wrap list page charts in details.kb-stats[data-fold-on-phone].

rules.quote: the /cves/ table stacks into cards below 640px
rules.rule: Stack the /cves/ table into cards below 640px.

rules.quote: expands the last 7 days (`CHANGES_OPEN_DAYS`) and folds older days
rules.rule: Expand the last 7 days on /changes/ and fold older days.

rules.quote: Docs under /about/ use the reading measure.
rules.rule: Use the reading measure for docs under /about/.

rules.quote: dims non-matching cells by background + `--text-muted` (never opacity)
rules.rule: Dim non-matching /attack/ compare cells with background and --text-muted, never opacity.

rules.quote: the Navigator export reads the same `passingTechniques()` roll-up as the matrix
rules.rule: Make the Navigator export read the same passingTechniques() roll-up as the matrix.

rules.quote: The matrix box is viewport-capped with sticky tactic headers and the legend above it.
rules.rule: Cap the ATT&CK matrix box to the viewport with sticky tactic headers and the legend above it.

rules.quote: `touch-action: pan-y` until the canvas is tapped
rules.rule: Set touch-action: pan-y on the graph canvas until it is tapped.

rules.quote: a server-rendered type legend from the same `--g-*` tokens
rules.rule: Render the /graph/ type legend server-side from the --g-* tokens.

rules.quote: a device-neutral "path to…" action (no shift-click only)
rules.rule: Provide a device-neutral "path to…" action on /graph/ rather than shift-click only.

rules.quote: Internal links use →, external ↗.
rules.rule: Mark internal links with → and external links with ↗.

rules.quote: render plain text (`_source_ref`), never a 404
rules.rule: Render unknown source ids as plain text via _source_ref, never as a 404 link.

rules.quote: `var(--muted)` is NOT a token
rules.rule: Never use var(--muted); it is not a token.

rules.quote: unless it carries two classes
rules.rule: Give a class rule two classes when it must beat .view h2 or .brief-prose h2.

rules.quote: must account for classes built by concatenation
rules.rule: Account for concatenated class names before deleting any CSS in the orphan check.

rules.quote: `source` (required) = the entry id whose cited reporting establishes the edge
rules.rule: Every relations[] edge must include a source field naming the entry id whose cited reporting establishes the edge.

rules.quote: Symmetric types stored ONCE (mirror declaration = duplicate-edge FAIL)
rules.rule: Store an edge of a symmetric relation type once, and do not add a mirrored copy of it.

rules.quote: directed types live on the SUBJECT
rules.rule: Store a directed relation edge on its subject entity, not on its object.

rules.quote: attached from `affected_products[]` only (NEVER prose phrase-matching)
rules.rule: Attach product-type entities only from an entry's affected_products[] field, never by matching product names in prose.

rules.quote: nothing points out of one except `documented-in`/`related-to`
rules.rule: Do not create outgoing edges from a product entity except of type documented-in or related-to.

rules.quote: Relate only what a source states
rules.rule: Create a relation edge only when a cited source states that relationship.

rules.quote: an overlap claim is `overlaps-with`, never upgraded
rules.rule: Record an overlap claim as an overlaps-with edge and never upgrade it to a stronger relation type.

rules.quote: a suspected same-entity is an alias or a tombstone, not a relation
rules.rule: Record a suspected same-entity match as an alias or a tombstone, never as a relation edge.

rules.quote: New corroboration ≠ new edge
rules.rule: Do not create a new edge when new corroboration arrives for an existing relationship.

rules.quote: a materially evolved relationship updates the edge's `type`/`source`/`note` in place
rules.rule: When a relationship has materially evolved, update the existing edge's type, source, and note in place.

rules.quote: Co-occurrence, entity↔CVE and entity↔technique edges are derived at render time, never stored.
rules.rule: Never store co-occurrence, entity-to-CVE, or entity-to-technique edges; they are derived at render time.

rules.quote: `name` = concise canonical entity name only (never the reporting vendor, never a headline)
rules.rule: Set an entity's name to its concise canonical name only, never the reporting vendor's name or a headline.

rules.quote: Composers still link `entities:` explicitly
rules.rule: When composing entries, explicitly link entities in the entities: field.

rules.quote: `merged_into: <canonical-key>` tombstone (no chains; edges move to the canonical record)
rules.rule: When merging a duplicate entity, replace it with a merged_into: <canonical-key> tombstone, avoid chains of tombstones, and move its edges to the canonical record.

rules.quote: never reference a tombstone in new entries
rules.rule: Do not reference a tombstone entity key in newly written entries.

rules.quote: Orphan duplicates (zero references) may be deleted outright, names folded into aliases
rules.rule: An orphan duplicate entity with zero references may be deleted, with its names folded into the canonical entity's aliases.

rules.quote: a referenced mistyped key gets a tombstone pointing at a new correctly-typed record
rules.rule: When a referenced entity key has the wrong type, replace it with a tombstone pointing to a new, correctly typed record.

rules.quote: Research agents may return `relation_suggestions: [{subject, object, basis}]`
rules.rule: Expect research agents to return relation_suggestions as subject, object, and basis triples.

rules.quote: the main agent maps onto the vocabulary and owns the write
rules.rule: As the main agent, map research relation suggestions onto the relation type vocabulary and perform the write yourself.

rules.quote: Don't reintroduce a horizon filter
rules.rule: Do not reintroduce a horizon filter (such as build.operational_entries/strategic_entries or horizon checks in brief.js), because all entries now share the same shape.

rules.quote: Developments/corrections/improvements = `updates[]` records + `## <Type> — <at>` sections ON the original entry.
rules.rule: Record developments, corrections, and improvements as updates[] records plus dated `## <Type> — <at>` sections on the original entry, not as new entries.

rules.quote: `internal: true` = metadata-only fix: no section, never rendered, never moves `updated_at`.
rules.rule: Mark metadata-only fixes with `internal: true` and add no section for them.

rules.quote: only identity (`id`/path, `discovered_at`, `run_id`, `migrated_from`) and the append-only `updates[]` records are untouchable
rules.rule: Never modify identity fields (id/path, discovered_at, run_id, migrated_from) or existing updates[] records.

rules.quote: may all be revised in place when the modifying fire's record cleanly declares every change
rules.rule: Revise frontmatter, main analysis, and earlier section text in place only when the modifying fire's record cleanly declares every change (including fields and body).

rules.quote: ONE record per fire per entry
rules.rule: Write at most one updates[] record per entry per fire.

rules.quote: `at` strictly later than the entry's last activity
rules.rule: Set the `at` of a new updates[] record strictly later than the entry's last activity.

rules.quote: on an overtake re-read the entry on `origin/main` first
rules.rule: On an overtake, re-read the entry from origin/main before writing an update.

rules.quote: `actions[]` is the CURRENT do-now set — replace, never accumulate.
rules.rule: Replace actions[] with the current do-now set; never accumulate actions across updates.

rules.quote: `headline`/`summary` change only when a summary-only reader must now know something different.
rules.rule: Change headline or summary only when a summary-only reader must now know something different.

rules.quote: A correction fixes the wrong text IN PLACE and adds the dated section
rules.rule: For a correction, fix the wrong text in place and add the dated section.

rules.quote: grep the same fact across title/headline/summary/body/evidence/cves after
rules.rule: After a correction, grep the same fact across title, headline, summary, body, evidence, and cves.

rules.quote: stage with `git add -u entries/`
rules.rule: When updating an entry outside entries/<RUN_DATE>/, stage the change with `git add -u entries/` before shipping.

rules.quote: Bookkeeping that changes nothing a reader acts on is not a record
rules.rule: Do not create an updates[] record for bookkeeping that changes nothing a reader acts on.

rules.quote: `content_model.load_entry` must deep-copy `ENTRY_DEFAULTS`
rules.rule: Make content_model.load_entry deep-copy ENTRY_DEFAULTS so entries do not share mutable default lists such as updates.

rules.quote: For every KEV addition, read the CVE record's references first
rules.rule: For every KEV addition, read the CVE record's references before judging whether the CVE is relevant or dropping it as borderline.

rules.quote: read the CVE record's `references[]`, then search the vendor name plus CVE id plus the product's usual research firms before any borderline-drop
rules.rule: In Phase 2, for each KEV row, read the CVE record's references[] and search the vendor name, CVE id, and the product's usual research firms before dropping the CVE as borderline.

rules.quote: Cite the research page or the vendor advisory, never the cveawg/NVD/MITRE record
rules.rule: Cite the research page or vendor advisory as the source, never the cveawg, NVD, or MITRE CVE record.

rules.quote: a score or scope difference seen only there goes in `sourcing_note` as provenance
rules.rule: Record a score or scope difference that appears only in the cveawg, NVD, or MITRE record in the sourcing_note field as provenance, not as a cited source.

rules.quote: never re-date their cites
rules.rule: Never re-date inline citations in sections written by earlier fires.

rules.quote: a global string replace on a cite changes earlier fires' sections too, so restore them from `git show HEAD:<path>`
rules.rule: Do not apply a global string replace to a citation, since it changes earlier fires' sections; if that happened, restore those sections from git show HEAD:<path>.

rules.quote: a live vendor page that moves during the run (Palo Alto hotfix counts) is better stated count-free ("most hotfixes released") outside the section that dates the reading
rules.rule: When a live vendor page may change during the run, state its figures count-free (e.g. "most hotfixes released") outside the section that dates the reading.

rules.quote: Treat any legacy entry as unverified until `state/legacy_review.json` marks it reviewed.
rules.rule: Treat any legacy entry as unverified until state/legacy_review.json marks it reviewed.

rules.quote: Never build on its claims (references, registry relations, dedup "already covered") without checking the primary.
rules.rule: Never build on a legacy entry's claims (references, registry relations, dedup "already covered" judgments) without checking the primary source.

rules.quote: `python3 tools/legacy_review.py --next 20`
rules.rule: When auditing legacy entries, take the next batch from the queue with `python3 tools/legacy_review.py --next 20`.

rules.quote: re-verify, correct or rewrite from sources, `--done <run-id> <ids>`.
rules.rule: When auditing legacy entries, re-verify each one, correct or rewrite it from sources, then mark it done with `--done <run-id> <ids>`.

rules.quote: Touching a legacy entry pulls it under current gates: it needs a classification and a non-empty `techniques[]` (kind permitting) in the same record.
rules.rule: When editing a legacy entry, include a classification and a non-empty techniques[] (where the entry's kind permits) in the same record.

rules.quote: are folded with `tools/fold_entries.py` after the survivor's record is written
rules.rule: Fold duplicate entries with tools/fold_entries.py only after the survivor's record is written.

rules.quote: deletion is only legal that way
rules.rule: Delete duplicate entries only through the fold mechanism (tools/fold_entries.py).

rules.quote: When one side of a pair is already verified, put the reference there;
rules.rule: When one entry in a pair is already verified, add the references[] link on the verified entry, not the legacy one.

rules.quote: touching the legacy side means re-verifying it whole.
rules.rule: When touching the legacy side of a pair, re-verify the entire legacy entry.

rules.quote: Claim the audit on `main` before the first spawn
rules.rule: Claim the audit on main before the first sub-agent spawn by writing work/<run-id>/audit.claim.

rules.quote: stand down on a live claim under 48 h old
rules.rule: Stand down when a live audit claim on main is less than 48 hours old.

rules.quote: stand down as `superseded` when a later audit claims over a paused one
rules.rule: Stand down as superseded when a later audit claims over a paused audit.

rules.quote: At most 20 spawns per fire
rules.rule: Spawn at most 20 sub-agents per audit fire.

rules.quote: logged in `budget.tsv`
rules.rule: Log every sub-agent spawn in budget.tsv.

rules.quote: Findings on text the fire did not change are `(pre-existing)` advisories for the next audit
rules.rule: Label findings on text the audit fire did not change as (pre-existing) advisories for the next audit.

rules.quote: except an unsupported fact (F4)
rules.rule: Do not downgrade an unsupported fact (F4) to a pre-existing advisory, even if the fire did not change that text.

rules.quote: Legacy batches and the store-wide duplicate scan are secondary work.
rules.rule: Treat legacy batches and the store-wide duplicate scan as secondary work, not as part of the audit.

rules.quote: In an interactive session, finish the audit and confirm it is live before doing any other work.
rules.rule: In an interactive session, finish the audit and confirm it is live before starting any other work.

rules.quote: All other work should only be done when this is successfully pushed and live.
rules.rule: Do other work only after the audit has been successfully pushed and is live.

rules.quote: focus on the primary work and that is auditing the previous week
rules.rule: Focus audits on their primary work: auditing the previous week.

rules.quote: Ensure audits do not overrun their session limits anymore.
rules.rule: Ensure audits do not exceed their session limits.

rules.quote: Read `prompts/cleanup-coordinator.md` on `main` and continue the store cleanup program.
rules.rule: To start or continue the cleanup program, read prompts/cleanup-coordinator.md on main and continue the store cleanup program from there.

rules.quote: One wave per session, at most 20 spawns per wave.
rules.rule: Run only one cleanup wave per session, and spawn at most 20 sub-agents per wave.

rules.quote: Each wave writes a `partial` claim, which the scheduled weekly audit ignores, and yields to the weekly audit's claim.
rules.rule: Each cleanup wave must write a partial claim, and it must yield to the weekly audit's claim.

rules.quote: Each wave ships on its own `claude/cleanup-wave-*` branch, so the auto-merge lands it.
rules.rule: Ship each cleanup wave on its own claude/cleanup-wave-* branch so that auto-merge lands it.

rules.quote: The reference branch `cleanup/2026-10-18-carry-forward` holds unverified drafts. It is never merged; ports are re-verified and re-recorded under the porting wave's run id.
rules.rule: Never merge the reference branch cleanup/2026-10-18-carry-forward; instead, re-verify and re-record any ported items under the porting wave's run id.

rules.quote: The program ends by retiring `quality-audit.md` § Secondary work and `tools/legacy_review.py`.
rules.rule: When the cleanup program ends, retire the Secondary work section of quality-audit.md and the tools/legacy_review.py file.

rules.quote: Only a wave the tracker marks `ready`, whose `after` waves are done, and for which `python3 work/cleanup/render_status.py --check-lanes` passes.
rules.rule: Start a cleanup wave only if the tracker marks it `ready`, all waves in its `after` list are done, and `python3 work/cleanup/render_status.py --check-lanes` passes.

rules.quote: Start a wave with "Read `prompts/cleanup-coordinator.md` on `main` and run cleanup wave <NN>."
rules.rule: To start a cleanup wave, read `prompts/cleanup-coordinator.md` on `main` and run cleanup wave <NN>.

rules.quote: The claim reads `partial <STARTED> wave=<NN>`.
rules.rule: Write the wave claim as `partial <STARTED> wave=<NN>`.

rules.quote: The claim commit also marks the wave `in-flight <run-id>` and its rows `in-wave <NN>` in `work/cleanup/plan.json`
rules.rule: In the claim commit, mark the wave `in-flight <run-id>` and its rows `in-wave <NN>` in `work/cleanup/plan.json`.

rules.quote: A wave touches only its own rows' entries.
rules.rule: A cleanup wave may modify only the entries belonging to its own rows.

rules.quote: A legacy batch is its row's entry list, never `legacy_review.py --next`.
rules.rule: Define a legacy batch as the row's entry list; never use `legacy_review.py --next` to select a legacy batch.

rules.quote: Shared-file conflicts go to `python3 tools/merge_state.py resolve`
rules.rule: Resolve shared-file conflicts by running `python3 tools/merge_state.py resolve`.

rules.quote: Every wave keeps its 20-spawn cap
rules.rule: Every cleanup wave must keep its 20-spawn cap.

rules.quote: a rate-limited wave is cut, never retried in a loop.
rules.rule: When a cleanup wave is rate-limited, cut the wave; never retry it in a loop.

rules.quote: Metadata-only fixes (frontmatter/structured-field corrections with nothing to tell the reader) are `updates[]` records with `internal: true`
rules.rule: For metadata-only fixes with nothing to tell the reader, record them as updates[] entries with internal: true.

rules.quote: no `## <Type> — <at>` section, never rendered on the site, changelog-only
rules.rule: Do not give internal: true update records a section, do not render them on the site; keep them changelog-only.

rules.quote: Composition-rationale narration in bodies ("`actions[]` is empty because…", "`techniques[]` maps only…", registry keys, "this pipeline/store/run") is a defect; the fix is deletion.
rules.rule: Never include composition-rationale or pipeline-internal narration (such as registry keys or references to the pipeline, store, or run) in entry bodies; delete it instead.

rules.quote: Only `type: update` moves `updated_at`.
rules.rule: Only type: update records may change updated_at; corrections and improvements must not re-float an entry.

rules.quote: `updated_at` = last non-internal `type: update` record's `at`, null when none.
rules.rule: Set updated_at to the at value of the last non-internal type: update record, or null if there is none.

rules.quote: Reader-facing corrections keep their sections (rendered on the entry page and day-page § Updates by record `at`).
rules.rule: Keep sections for reader-facing corrections so they render on the entry page and in the day-page Updates section by record at.

rules.quote: Short, relevant, actionable beats more.
rules.rule: Prefer short, relevant, actionable content over longer content.

rules.quote: Completeness stays a hard duty ONLY for critical/high signal; below that, a marginal item is dropped or held to two sentences.
rules.rule: Aim for completeness only for critical or high-signal items; for marginal items below that bar, drop them or limit them to two sentences.

rules.quote: The brief must save the team time — if they have to re-triage it, it failed.
rules.rule: Write briefs so they save the team time, so that they do not need to re-triage the content.

rules.quote: Non-English sources are quoted in English translation marked "(translated from <language>)"
rules.rule: Quote non-English sources in English translation marked "(translated from <language>)".

rules.quote: the verbatim original goes in `evidence[].original` (optional field, renderer ignores it)
rules.rule: Put the verbatim original non-English quotation in evidence[].original so it can be verified against the fetched page.

rules.quote: **Model pins are the generic `sonnet` alias**, never a dated id
rules.rule: Pin models using the generic sonnet alias, never a dated model ID.

rules.quote: heise-sec and inside-it-ch are operator-named critical sources** → `tier: essential` (attempted every fire)
rules.rule: Set tier: essential for heise-sec and inside-it-ch sources and attempt them on every run.

rules.quote: Entry content is modifiable when changelog-tracked
rules.rule: Entry content may be modified when the change is tracked in the changelog.

rules.quote: main-agent default `effortLevel: xhigh` in `.claude/settings.json`; both sub-agent definitions carry `effort: xhigh`
rules.rule: Set the main agent's default effortLevel to xhigh in .claude/settings.json and give both sub-agent definitions effort: xhigh.

rules.quote: Re-enable a plugin only when a task genuinely needs it.
rules.rule: Re-enable a disabled plugin only when a task genuinely needs it.

rules.quote: every run must end
rules.rule: Ensure every run terminates; termination is guaranteed structurally (finite work lists, bounded continuations, retry and iteration caps, no self-re-spawning), not by a time limit.

rules.quote: Remove the time limits and allow a run to take as long as it needs.
rules.rule: Do not impose time limits on runs or sub-agents; let a run take as long as it needs.

rules.quote: 60 minutes with no write under `work/<run-id>/` and no completion notification = stalled
rules.rule: Treat a run as stalled only after 60 minutes with no write under work/<run-id>/ and no completion notification.

rules.quote: Sub-agents append a line to `work/<run-id>/<domain>.progress` (research) or `verify.iter<N>.progress` (verifier) per unit finished
rules.rule: Sub-agents must append a line to their progress file (work/<run-id>/<domain>.progress for research, verify.iter<N>.progress for verifier) for each unit of work finished.

rules.quote: Do not force the runs to produce certain amount of entries.
rules.rule: Do not force runs to produce a certain number of entries.

rules.quote: No entry is also okay
rules.rule: Zero entries is an acceptable outcome for a run.

rules.quote: the agent can judge itself
rules.rule: Let the agent judge for itself how many items to produce and how to treat them, rather than following fixed counts.

rules.quote: Deep-dive category rotation is a tie-breaker, never a reason to pass over the most deserving item.
rules.rule: Use deep-dive category rotation only as a tie-breaker; never pass over the most deserving item because of category rotation.

rules.quote: never cut, rush or sample work because of elapsed time
rules.rule: Never cut, rush, or sample work because of elapsed time.

rules.quote: never add a count-based rule
rules.rule: Never add a count-based rule.

rules.quote: when a number appears in a prompt, read it as the typical case unless it is one of the termination bounds above
rules.rule: Read a number appearing in a prompt as the typical case, not a hard requirement, unless it is a termination bound.

rules.quote: Never re-add `Write(...)` permission rules — use `Edit(...)`.
rules.rule: Never add `Write(...)` permission rules to Claude Code settings; use `Edit(...)` rules instead to cover file-editing tools.

rules.quote: a `Write(path)` allow rule is never consulted and triggers a startup warning
rules.rule: Do not write `Write(path)` allow rules, since Claude Code never consults them and they trigger a startup warning.

rules.quote: The entry is never rewritten.
rules.rule: Do not rewrite an entry's affected_products[] to a canonical product name; keep the release-precise spelling and resolve the product key at render time.

rules.quote: Bare integers are never stripped.
rules.rule: When deriving a product key, never strip a bare trailing integer from a product name (e.g., keep "Microsoft 365" intact); strip only a 4-digit release year, a dotted version, a vN/rN suffix, or an edition word.

rules.quote: Products never phrase-match prose.
rules.rule: Do not attach product entities to entries by phrase-matching their prose; attach them only from the entry's affected_products[] field.

rules.quote: never the right move
rules.rule: Do not regenerate all of entities/registry.yaml with a full dump_yaml_subset re-dump to update products; update products with tools/sync_products.py, which rewrites only its marked block at the end of the file.

rules.quote: Add the loser's spelling to the winner's `aliases` (or `merged_into`) and re-run
rules.rule: To merge two products, add the losing product's spelling to the winner's aliases (or set merged_into on the loser), then re-run tools/sync_products.py instead of migrating entries.

rules.quote: `summary` is OPTIONAL on `product` records
rules.rule: Omit the summary field on product records when no analytical summary is warranted; do not fabricate one.

rules.quote: and never become entities.
rules.rule: Do not create entities for vendor-only strings such as "Microsoft" or "Linux"; these are listed in PRODUCT_NON_ENTITIES and must be excluded.

rules.quote: The row is suppressed on `type: product`
rules.rule: On product pages, do not show the "Affected products" row; show the CVEs and Releases covered rows instead.

rules.quote: The alias line then shows only what the releases row did not
rules.rule: On product pages, show in the alias line only aliases that are not already listed in the Releases covered row.

rules.quote: Non-product pages keep "Affected products" unchanged
rules.rule: On non-product pages, keep the "Affected products" row unchanged.

rules.quote: capped at 24
rules.rule: On product pages, cap the CVEs row at 24 entries, listing exploited/KEV CVEs first.

rules.quote: WARN, never FAIL
rules.rule: Make the product-entities check in check_run.py report unregistered product spellings as WARN, never FAIL.

rules.quote: NEVER a dated id (operator directive 2026-08-28)
rules.rule: Sub-agent definitions must pin the generic `model: sonnet` alias, never a dated model ID.

rules.quote: Never change effort unilaterally.
rules.rule: Never change the effort level unilaterally; effort changes must go through the operator and the generation baseline review.

rules.quote: Never reintroduce an Opus pin or a second verifier definition.
rules.rule: Never reintroduce an Opus model pin for sub-agents, and never add a second verifier definition.

rules.quote: never ask an agent to write out its reasoning (`reasoning_extraction` declines).
rules.rule: Never ask an agent to write out its reasoning.

rules.quote: Quote it verbatim on the `**Model:**` line.
rules.rule: When recording model self-identification, quote the harness-injected model line from the agent's own system prompt verbatim on the `**Model:**` line.

rules.quote: always carry the marker `— container default, env fallback`
rules.rule: When self-identifying via env vars (CLAUDE_FRIENDLY_NAME/CLAUDE_MODEL_ID), always include the marker `— container default, env fallback`.

rules.quote: `Anthropic Claude (specific model not determined)` — never a training-data guess.
rules.rule: When the specific model cannot be determined, report `Anthropic Claude (specific model not determined)` and never guess the model from training data.

rules.quote: a confirmation pass after a CLEAN receives nothing but the fact of the CLEAN.
rules.rule: A confirmation pass after a CLEAN verdict receives nothing but the fact of the CLEAN.

rules.quote: an iteration after a NEEDS_FIXES receives the prior deltas block;
rules.rule: An iteration after a NEEDS_FIXES verdict receives the prior deltas block.

rules.quote: never ask an agent to write out its reasoning
rules.rule: Do not ask agents to write out their reasoning.

rules.quote: work off the gap to the last run
rules.rule: When assessing a scheduler gap, work off the gap to the last run.

rules.quote: a changed cadence is never a finding
rules.rule: Never report a changed run cadence as a finding.

rules.quote: surface big gaps
rules.rule: Surface large gaps in the run schedule.

rules.quote: don't re-diagnose the repo
rules.rule: Do not re-diagnose the repo when a schedule gap is found.

rules.quote: Commit destructive work the moment it is coherent.
rules.rule: Commit destructive changes as soon as they form a coherent unit.

rules.quote: Before restoring anything that looks like corruption, run `git status`
rules.rule: Before restoring any files that look corrupted, run `git status`.

rules.quote: look for staged deletions
rules.rule: When checking git status before restoring apparently corrupted files, look for staged deletions.

rules.quote: `ListAgents` + `SendMessage` to the peer name is the coordination channel
rules.rule: Coordinate with a concurrent peer session using ListAgents and SendMessage to the peer's name.

rules.quote: agree on path ownership up front
rules.rule: Agree with a concurrent peer session on path ownership before starting work.

rules.quote: They are noise, not signal.
rules.rule: Treat untracked conflict copies in the working tree as noise, not as evidence of repo corruption.

rules.quote: Check `origin/main` at every phase boundary, not only Phase 6.
rules.rule: Check `origin/main` at every phase boundary, not only at Phase 6.

rules.quote: Dedup by **reading**, not by index
rules.rule: Deduplicate overtaken-run entries by reading their content, not by comparing index values.

rules.quote: Resolve a conflicted merge with `python3 tools/merge_state.py resolve`
rules.rule: Resolve a conflicted merge using `python3 tools/merge_state.py resolve`.

rules.quote: check that entity
rules.rule: When merge_state prints a NOTE about an entity edited on both sides, check that entity.

rules.quote: Check your *tooling* diffs by reading, not by merge
rules.rule: Check tooling diffs by reading them, not by merging them.

rules.quote: its `at` must be later than that entry's last activity
rules.rule: Set a surviving duplicate's changelog record `at` later than the overtaking entry's last activity.

rules.quote: re-read the target entry on `origin/main` for a newer record before appending yours
rules.rule: Before appending a changelog record, re-read the target entry on `origin/main` for a newer record.

rules.quote: one record per fire
rules.rule: Append at most one changelog record per fire.

rules.quote: `at` strictly increasing
rules.rule: Ensure each changelog record's `at` is strictly greater than the previous one.

rules.quote: a second correction of the same defect is no record at all
rules.rule: Do not append a second changelog record correcting the same defect.

rules.quote: A dropped entry's non-actionable extra fact goes to a correction-owed row in `state/coverage_backlog.md`.
rules.rule: Record a dropped entry's non-actionable extra fact as a correction-owed row in `state/coverage_backlog.md`.

rules.quote: diff the row sets via `git show :1:/:2:/:3:`
rules.rule: When backlog rows appear duplicated after a merge, diff the row sets via `git show :1:/:2:/:3:`.

rules.quote: if the finding names a mechanism, the mechanism is the work item.
rules.rule: When a verifier finding names a mechanism, treat fixing that mechanism as the work item.

rules.quote: every pass answers for every claim in scope
rules.rule: Every verifier pass must answer for every claim in scope of the verification loop.

rules.quote: an incomplete pass's CLEAN never counts
rules.rule: Never count a CLEAN result from an incomplete verifier pass.

rules.quote: If the loop still does not converge, look at claim coverage first (`--coverage N`), not at adding passes.
rules.rule: If the verifier loop does not converge, check claim coverage first (with --coverage N) before adding verification passes.

rules.quote: no vector/actor/behavior ⇒ routine, two sentences
rules.rule: Classify an incident with no identified vector, actor, or behavior as routine and write it in two sentences.

rules.quote: Recounting unchanged source material is a `correction`, never an `update`
rules.rule: Record recounting of unchanged source material as a correction, never as an update.

rules.quote: mandatory supersession sweep (Phase 4 § Updating step 4)
rules.rule: Run the supersession sweep (cti-run.md Phase 4, Updating step 4) whenever updating an entry.

rules.quote: every row is published, struck, or held with a named, dated condition and a 14-day expiry
rules.rule: Every backlog row must be published, struck, or held with a named, dated condition that expires after 14 days.

rules.quote: no carry-forward notes
rules.rule: Do not write carry-forward notes on backlog rows.

rules.quote: Fix: `tools/merge_state.py` in the workflow, Phase 6 and session start.
rules.rule: Merge state files with tools/merge_state.py in the workflow, Phase 6, and session start instead of whole-file --ours/--theirs.

rules.quote: every entry closes with `**Exposure:**`, `**Detection:**`, `**Triage:**` (honest only), `**Defender takeaway:**`
rules.rule: Every entry must close with the labeled fields Exposure, Detection, Triage, and Defender takeaway.

rules.quote: `**Triage:**` (honest only)
rules.rule: Write the Triage field honestly, without overstating or understating triage status.

rules.quote: heise bodies now read with `extract` (no reader).
rules.rule: Read heise article bodies with extract, not the reader tool.

rules.quote: Tools now take "now" from the run id / `--now "$STARTED"` (verified clock)
rules.rule: Take the current time in tools from the run id or from --now "$STARTED" (verified clock), not from the local clock.

rules.quote: the intel window anchors on `runs.last_intel_run`
rules.rule: Anchor the intel window on runs.last_intel_run.

rules.quote: a failed fetch no longer advances a source's rotation cursor
rules.rule: Do not advance a source's rotation cursor when its fetch fails.

rules.quote: Never reintroduce a full page there — one canonical URL for the brief.
rules.rule: Never serve a full page at /live/; keep /live/ as a noindex meta-refresh stub that redirects to /.

rules.quote: do not reintroduce them.
rules.rule: Do not reintroduce the retired .hero--live, .live-lede, and .rangebar blocks in build.py or the CSS.

rules.quote: do not reintroduce them.
rules.rule: Do not reintroduce § Do now, the ACT NOW card, or the window pulse panel in build.py, brief.js, or the CSS.

rules.quote: but a very short critical alarm.
rules.rule: Place nothing between the page head and the findings except a very short critical alarm.

rules.quote: It follows the WINDOW, never the chip filters.
rules.rule: Make the critical alarm follow the reading window, never the chip filters.

rules.quote: Hidden empty container when there is none.
rules.rule: Hide the critical alarm container when the window has no critical entries.

rules.quote: for notification hooks only.
rules.rule: Use the 7-day open_criticals span in data/alerts.json only for notification hooks, never for the on-page alarm.

rules.quote: The window is named by the `<select>` alone
rules.rule: Name the reading window only through the window <select> control, with no separate label.

rules.quote: "load older" past the preset choices appends a matching option so the control never lies.
rules.rule: When "load older" goes past the preset window choices, append a matching option to the window <select>.

rules.quote: never hijacks a text selection
rules.rule: Timeline row click handling must never hijack a text selection.

rules.quote: the full text stays in the DOM for agents.
rules.rule: When clamping summaries with CSS, keep the full summary text in the DOM.

rules.quote: not "open ↗"
rules.rule: Label the timeline CTA "Full analysis →", not "open ↗".

rules.quote: UPD rows name "first published …" in the meta row.
rules.rule: Have UPD timeline rows name "first published …" in the meta row.

rules.quote: internal links to the brief use the page prefix alone (`prefix or "./"`)
rules.rule: Link to the brief using the page prefix alone (`prefix or "./"`).

rules.quote: never `live/`.
rules.rule: Never link to the brief with a `live/` path.

rules.quote: briefbook.json URLs stay `../`-prefixed
rules.rule: Keep briefbook.json URLs prefixed with `../`.

rules.quote: stay branding-driven, no identity literals in build.py
rules.rule: Keep nav labels, hero text, and live_title branding-driven, with no identity literals in build.py.

rules.quote: don't mistake one for a regression when spot-checking.
rules.rule: Do not treat a missing index.md on a folded-entry redirect stub as a regression when spot-checking.

rules.quote: never demote a source for a 403 / anti-bot challenge / exhausted reader credit
rules.rule: Never demote a source because of a 403 response, an anti-bot challenge, or exhausted reader credit; treat a block as a transport problem.

rules.quote: Avoid `WebFetch` for article bodies `extract` reads
rules.rule: Do not use WebFetch to read article bodies that extract can read, because the summariser drops detail.

rules.quote: use it for walled hosts, liveness checks and link discovery
rules.rule: Use WebFetch for walled hosts, liveness checks, and link discovery.

rules.quote: `jina <URL>` only for `fetch_method: jina` hosts (none today) or after every other rung failed
rules.rule: Use jina only for hosts with fetch_method: jina, or after every other rung of the fetch ladder has failed.

rules.quote: bacs.admin.ch articles read with `extract`.
rules.rule: Read bacs.admin.ch articles with extract.

rules.quote: ICS: `cisa csaf-recent [N]` / `cisa csaf <icsa-id>`
rules.rule: For CISA ICS advisories, use `cisa csaf-recent [N]` for recent items and `cisa csaf <icsa-id>` for a specific advisory.

rules.quote: KEV = `cisa-kev` (own subcommand, no reader)
rules.rule: For CISA KEV data, use the `cisa-kev` subcommand, not a reader.

rules.quote: news, alerts, AA-series, directives: `WebFetch` with the outbound-links template
rules.rule: For CISA news, alerts, AA-series, and directives, use WebFetch with the outbound-links template.

rules.quote: OSV.dev: `osv query <ecosystem> <pkg>` / `osv vuln <GHSA-or-CVE>`
rules.rule: For GitHub Advisory DB data, use OSV.dev via `osv query <ecosystem> <pkg>` or `osv vuln <GHSA-or-CVE>`.

rules.quote: cite `github.com/advisories/<GHSA>`
rules.rule: Cite GitHub advisories as github.com/advisories/<GHSA>.

rules.quote: distro trackers: `ubuntu.com/security/CVE-…`, `security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-…` — count as `role: primary`
rules.rule: For kernel.org CVEs, use the distro trackers (ubuntu.com/security/CVE-… or security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-…) and count them as role: primary.

rules.quote: `feed https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/api/1/services/v1/all-rss-feed.xml`
rules.rule: For ncsc-uk, read the feed at https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/api/1/services/v1/all-rss-feed.xml, not the HTML listing.

rules.quote: JSON API `https://api.ransomware.live/v2/countryvictims/<CC>` — discovery only
rules.rule: Use the ransomware.live JSON API only for discovery.

rules.quote: leak-site claims stay single-source
rules.rule: Keep ransomware.live leak-site claims single-sourced.

rules.quote: `extract <url>` reads both pages in full via trafilatura-direct
rules.rule: Read NCSC-CH/BACS pages with extract <url>, which uses trafilatura-direct.

rules.quote: if you find them on `jina` again, that is the bug
rules.rule: If NCSC-CH/BACS pages are being fetched through jina, treat that as a bug to fix.

rules.quote: cite `security-hub.ncsc.admin.ch/#/posts/<id>`
rules.rule: Cite NCSC-CSH posts as security-hub.ncsc.admin.ch/#/posts/<id>.

rules.quote: select on CONTENT TYPE, never as a failure rung
rules.rule: Select PDF extraction (fetch_source.py pdf) based on content type, never as a fallback rung after a failure.

rules.quote: mirrors (media.defense.gov, ic3.gov) count as the same document
rules.rule: Treat mirrored PDF advisories (media.defense.gov, ic3.gov) as the same document.

rules.quote: RSS `https://labs.infoguard.ch/rss.xml`
rules.rule: For infoguard-labs, read the RSS feed at https://labs.infoguard.ch/rss.xml.

rules.quote: `feed https://www.heise.de/security/feed.xml N` → `extract <article>`
rules.rule: For heise-sec, list items with feed https://www.heise.de/security/feed.xml N, then read each article with extract <article>.

rules.quote: free articles only
rules.rule: For heise-sec, read only free (non-paywalled) articles.

rules.quote: stay `blocked`
rules.rule: Keep coe.int and downloads.seppmail.com marked blocked, since the reader cannot reach them.

rules.quote: add an id ONLY after direct AND jina AND bridge all fail
rules.rule: Add a host to TRANSPORT_BLOCKED_UNREACHABLE only after direct, jina, and bridge fetches have all failed.

rules.quote: never conclude "pool exhausted" from a sub-agent's stderr
rules.rule: Never conclude that the jina key pool is exhausted from a sub-agent's stderr.

rules.quote: check `jina-usage` (whole-pool report)
rules.rule: Check jina-usage (the whole-pool report) before deciding the jina pool is exhausted.

rules.quote: keys never in the repo
rules.rule: Never store jina API keys in the repository.

rules.quote: Quality audit runs `jina-usage` every fire.
rules.rule: Run jina-usage on every quality audit fire.

rules.quote: Never demote
rules.rule: When the jina pool is dead, never demote the affected sources.

rules.quote: probe direct alternatives and record them
rules.rule: When the jina pool is dead, probe direct alternatives for affected sources and record the results.

rules.quote: NEVER "the document says nothing"
rules.rule: Treat a PDF with no extractable text objects as not extractable, never as a document that says nothing.

rules.quote: A CMap-approximated decode is labelled an approximation
rules.rule: Label any CMap-approximated PDF decode as an approximation.

rules.quote: selection between decodes is by volume of recovered prose, not a ratio
rules.rule: When choosing between PDF decodes, select by the volume of recovered prose, not by a ratio.

rules.quote: test extractor changes against a genuine advisory, not only the synthetic suite
rules.rule: Test PDF extractor changes against a genuine advisory, not only the synthetic test suite.

rules.quote: Decode per font, never file-wide
rules.rule: Decode each PDF string with its own font's ToUnicode map, never with a file-wide map.

rules.quote: suspect a regression here first
rules.rule: If a PDF reads as letter-shifted gibberish or has no digits, suspect a regression in per-font decoding first.

rules.quote: A `coverage_gaps` recipe-gap note is a repair order, not a status
rules.rule: Treat a coverage_gaps recipe-gap note as a repair order to act on, not as a status.

rules.quote: publish first coverage with a sourcing note
rules.rule: When a fixed feed's backlog appears, publish the first coverage with a sourcing note.

rules.quote: A probe must assert the shape the recipe promises, never a proxy
rules.rule: A health probe must assert the output shape the recipe promises, never a proxy such as byte count, non-empty output, or HTTP 200.

rules.quote: a structured query API (SEC EDGAR, OSV) with a small or empty result set is working, not a shell
rules.rule: Do not classify a structured query API (such as SEC EDGAR or OSV) with a small or empty result set as a shell.

rules.quote: general news feeds (`content_scope: general-news`) need only one security term
rules.rule: For general news feeds (content_scope: general-news), require only one security term to judge relevance.

rules.quote: trafilatura's `date:` header is the fetch date on listing pages, never item freshness
rules.rule: Never use the trafilatura date: header on listing pages as item freshness.

rules.quote: judge them on raw HTML + extract
rules.rule: Judge listing pages on their raw HTML plus extract output, since extract alone yields only page chrome.

rules.quote: A national-CERT domain change also needs `NATIONAL_CERT_HOSTS` in `check_run.py`
rules.rule: When a national CERT's domain changes, update NATIONAL_CERT_HOSTS in check_run.py.

rules.quote: A "reachable but stale" verdict needs the RAW body read in document order
rules.rule: Before concluding a source is reachable but stale, read the raw body in document order, not a truncated read.

rules.quote: so it probes with `url --direct`
rules.rule: For tiny pages like swarmcha-se, probe with url --direct so the reader fallback does not hide the result.

rules.quote: Do not spend reader calls on it
rules.rule: Do not spend reader calls on ssd-disclosure.com.

rules.quote: re-test after the cache lapses before trusting a single read
rules.rule: Re-test a WebFetch-read host after its 15-minute cache lapses before trusting a single read.

rules.quote: ask the prompt for the exact sentence
rules.rule: When quoting from a WebFetch-only page, ask the prompt for the exact sentence.

rules.quote: quote only what comes back verbatim
rules.rule: Quote only text that comes back verbatim from WebFetch.

rules.quote: discovery is `WebSearch site:ssd-disclosure.com` (leads only)
rules.rule: Discover ssd-disclosure.com items with WebSearch site:ssd-disclosure.com, treating results as leads only.

rules.quote: `cisa-kev` and `cisa csaf-recent` stay on the bridge
rules.rule: Keep cisa-kev and cisa csaf-recent on the bridge rather than WebFetch.

rules.quote: the audit spot-checks them with WebFetch
rules.rule: The audit spot-checks WebFetch-only sources with WebFetch.

rules.quote: Read the JSON before writing anything about a hotfix's release state
rules.rule: Before writing about a Palo Alto hotfix's release state, read the JSON timeline at security.paloaltonetworks.com/json/CVE-….

rules.quote: Print the full `value`, never a truncated slice.
rules.rule: Print the full timeline value when reading Palo Alto timeline JSON, never a truncated slice.

rules.quote: the reader (`jina <URL>`) renders it
rules.rule: Read HPE support.hpe.com docDisplay bulletins with jina, since in-container transports only get a JavaScript shell.

rules.quote: A claim absent from the CSAF/txt is not absent from the bulletin.
rules.rule: Do not conclude a claim is absent from an HPE bulletin just because it is missing from the CSAF or txt advisory.

rules.quote: never trust a remembered constant — derive it from the live file every time
rules.rule: Never rely on a remembered serialization constant for state files; derive the JSON format from the live file before every dump.

rules.quote: `head -3 <file> | cat -A`
rules.rule: Before dumping a state file, run `head -3 <file> | cat -A` on the live file to read its indentation.

rules.quote: check the last byte for a trailing newline
rules.rule: Before dumping a state file, check whether the live file's last byte is a trailing newline.

rules.quote: check whether non-ASCII is escaped
rules.rule: Before dumping a state file, check whether the live file escapes non-ASCII characters.

rules.quote: dump matching what you saw
rules.rule: After loading and mutating a state file, dump it using the same formatting observed in the live file.

rules.quote: `git diff --stat <file>`
rules.rule: After editing a state file, run `git diff --stat <file>` to verify the change size.

rules.quote: Whole-file churn ⇒ redump with the right flags.
rules.rule: If a state file's diff shows whole-file churn, redump it with the correct serialization flags.

rules.quote: `notes` is append-only
rules.rule: Only append to the `notes` field; never edit or remove existing notes entries.

rules.quote: Edit it textually instead
rules.rule: Edit sources/sources.json textually (regex on record blocks) instead of loading and dumping it.

rules.quote: insert new candidates before
rules.rule: When adding new candidates to sources/sources.json, insert them before the closing `]` of the candidates array, before the "statuses" section.

rules.quote: `state/cves_seen.json` still round-trips exactly at `indent=1, ensure_ascii=True` plus a trailing newline.
rules.rule: When dumping state/cves_seen.json, use indent=1, ensure_ascii=True, and a trailing newline.

rules.quote: an entry slug must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,59}$`
rules.rule: Ensure every entry slug matches the regex ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,59}$ (at most 60 characters).

rules.quote: name the file before writing it
rules.rule: Check the entry slug's length against the 60-character cap before writing the entry file.

rules.quote: dump with a Dumper whose `increase_indent` forces `indentless=False` and `default_flow_style=None`
rules.rule: When writing the run record YAML, use a Dumper whose increase_indent forces indentless=False and default_flow_style=None, so block sequences are indented.

rules.quote: Bump `last_seen` and append new records by text edit inside the record block
rules.rule: Update state/cves_seen.json by textual edits within record blocks (bump last_seen, append new records) instead of loading and dumping it.

rules.quote: regex the three counters inside each `{ ... }` block
rules.rule: When updating sources.json bookkeeping, use regex to update the three counters inside each record's block.

rules.quote: append candidate blocks before the closing `]`
rules.rule: When adding candidate blocks to sources.json, append them before the array's closing `]`.

rules.quote: derived layer only (markdown store stays source of truth)
rules.rule: Treat the markdown store as the source of truth and keep the STIX export as a derived layer only.

rules.quote: bundle URLs only — NO TAXII surface
rules.rule: Do not build a TAXII surface for the STIX export; publish bundle URLs only.

rules.quote: actor → `intrusion-set`
rules.rule: Export actor objects as STIX intrusion-set objects.

rules.quote: pure STIX (property extension, no `x_opencti_*`)
rules.rule: Do not use x_opencti_* properties in the STIX export; use pure STIX with property extensions only.

rules.quote: don't "fix" those vectors without operator sign-off
rules.rule: Do not change the pinned literal uuid test vectors in test_build.py without operator sign-off.

rules.quote: (never the `SITE_URL` env override)
rules.rule: Derive STIX id namespaces from the canonical branding site.url, never from the SITE_URL environment override.

rules.quote: Never put mutable text (titles, summaries) in a uuid5 seed.
rules.rule: Never include mutable text such as titles or summaries in a uuid5 seed.

rules.quote: Relation collapse table `SPEC_REL_MAP` in stix_model.py: only uses / attributed-to (incl. incident, malware→authored-by) / variant-of(malware) keep their names; everything else → `related-to`
rules.rule: In STIX relationships, keep the relationship names uses, attributed-to, and variant-of (malware) and map every other relationship type to related-to.

rules.quote: with `original_type` in the extension
rules.rule: When collapsing a relationship type to related-to, record the original type in the original_type extension property.

rules.quote: don't re-emit custom strings
