rules.rule: Do not emit custom relationship type strings in STIX bundles.

rules.quote: `report.object_refs` / `grouping.object_refs` are required non-empty
rules.rule: Ensure report and grouping objects have non-empty object_refs.

rules.quote: bare objects fall back to `[publisher identity id]`
rules.rule: When a report or grouping has no other objects to reference, set its object_refs to the publisher identity id.

rules.quote: STIX timestamps need ms precision — `stix_ts()` appends `.000`
rules.rule: Format STIX timestamps with millisecond precision by using stix_ts().

rules.quote: All exported attack-patterns use MITRE's canonical ids
rules.rule: Use MITRE's canonical ids for all exported attack-pattern objects.

rules.quote:
the uuid5 fallback exists
only for a pin written without the field
rules.rule: Use the uuid5 fallback for an attack-pattern id only when the ATT&CK pin lacks the stix_id field.

rules.quote: Report `modified` follows the latest changelog record of ANY type
rules.rule: Set a report's modified timestamp from the latest changelog record of any type.

rules.quote: stix2-validator is dev-only, never CI
rules.rule: Do not add stix2-validator to CI; use it only as a dev tool and keep the build stdlib-only.

rules.quote: validation there is the manual lint pattern
rules.rule: When pypi is blocked in the sandbox, validate STIX output with the manual lint pattern instead of stix2-validator.

rules.quote: never bulk-rewritten
rules.rule: Never bulk-rewrite migrated v2 entries (entries where migrated_from is not null).

rules.quote: an audit may lift one via an `improvement` record
rules.rule: When auditing a migrated v2 entry, raise its fidelity only through an improvement record.

rules.quote: the provenance flag never changes
rules.rule: Never change the provenance flag (migrated_from) of a migrated entry.

rules.quote: attack flow as observable behavior in vendor-neutral telemetry classes
rules.rule: Describe the attack flow in triage-ready entries as observable behavior in vendor-neutral telemetry classes.

rules.quote: ATT&CK complete in `techniques[]`
rules.rule: List the complete set of ATT&CK techniques in the techniques[] field of triage-ready entries.

rules.quote: prose readable without T-numbers
rules.rule: Write triage-ready prose so it is readable without ATT&CK T-numbers.

rules.quote: `affected_products[]` as official "Vendor Product" strings
rules.rule: Write affected_products[] values as official "Vendor Product" strings.

rules.quote: `**Triage:**` benign-lookalike discriminator omitted-never-invented
rules.rule: Omit the Triage benign-lookalike discriminator when it is unknown; never invent it.

rules.quote: **Never an em dash (`—`) anywhere a reader sees it.**
rules.rule: Never use an em dash (—) in any text the site renders for a reader, including chrome strings, entry prose, headlines, summaries, and docs.

rules.quote: never type one into `site/build.py`, `config/branding.yaml`,
rules.rule: Never type an em dash into site/build.py, config/branding.yaml, the CSS, or the JS, because the build will fail.

rules.quote: use `·` (the `NO_VALUE` constant), not a dash of any kind
rules.rule: Use `·` (the NO_VALUE constant) for empty-value table cells, never any kind of dash.

rules.quote: Aim late iterations explicitly at per-clause citation labels
rules.rule: When aiming late verifier iterations, explicitly target per-clause citation labels.

rules.quote: re-derive every count/date in the notes from the structured block
rules.rule: Re-derive every count and date in the notes from the structured block.

rules.quote: Leave ≥1 iteration completely unframed.
rules.rule: Leave at least one verifier iteration completely unframed.

rules.quote: After a NEEDS_FIXES, give the next iteration the deltas block
rules.rule: After a NEEDS_FIXES result, give the next iteration the deltas block.

rules.quote: a confirmation pass after a CLEAN gets nothing but the fact of the CLEAN
rules.rule: Give a confirmation pass after a CLEAN result nothing but the fact of the CLEAN.

rules.quote: Aim ≥1 iteration at the structured blocks, not the prose.
rules.rule: Aim at least one verifier iteration at the structured blocks rather than the prose.

rules.quote: Budget ≥2 iterations for a CLEAN publish.
rules.rule: Budget at least two verifier iterations before publishing after a CLEAN result.

rules.quote: Re-test every finding that changes a claim, quote or attribution against a fresh fetch (`grep -F` on the cached primary under `work/<run-id>/src/`) BEFORE applying
rules.rule: Before applying any verifier finding that changes a claim, quote or attribution, re-test it against a fresh fetch (grep -F on the cached primary under work/<run-id>/src/).

rules.quote: Invert the instinct: scrutinise the additive ones.
rules.rule: Scrutinise verifier findings that merely add a caveat rather than accepting them uncritically.

rules.quote: Record rebuttals in the run record with evidence
rules.rule: Record rebuttals of verifier findings in the run record, with evidence.

rules.quote: count them in the residual
rules.rule: Count rebutted verifier findings in the residual.

rules.quote: A verifier's "no action recommended" is advice, not a ruling.
rules.rule: Treat a verifier's "no action recommended" as advice, not a ruling.

rules.quote: do not train reflexive scepticism
rules.rule: Do not develop reflexive scepticism toward verifier findings.

rules.quote: carry the pattern, withhold example hostnames
rules.rule: When a vendor's detection rule describes a generation pattern, carry the pattern in the entry and withhold example hostnames.

rules.quote: `grep` every control name, privilege level and version string on the page before writing the sentence.
rules.rule: Before writing a sentence, grep every control name, privilege level and version string on the source page.

rules.quote: If a number is in your draft, it must be grep-able on the page.
rules.rule: Every number in a draft must be found by grep on the source page.

rules.quote: Every value in a structured field needs a source like a sentence
rules.rule: Give every value in a structured field a supporting source, as with a sentence.

rules.quote: Before commit, name the source sentence for every status flag.
rules.rule: Before committing, name the source sentence that supports every status flag.

rules.quote: "everyone knows" is PD-1 recall, drop it
rules.rule: Do not keep a status flag that rests only on recall; drop it unless a fetched source supports it.

rules.quote: `techniques[]` ids name behaviors the body describes AND a source supports
rules.rule: Only include technique ids whose behavior the body describes and a source supports.

rules.quote: Verify quotes against the live page, never against the findings YAML quoting it.
rules.rule: Verify quotes against the live page, never against the findings YAML that quotes it.

rules.quote: Strip HTML tags to the **empty string**, never a space
rules.rule: When stripping HTML tags from source text before quote checking, replace them with the empty string, never a space.

rules.quote: NBSP (`U+00A0`) in the source is part of the quote
rules.rule: Treat a non-breaking space (U+00A0) in the source as part of the quote.

rules.quote: whitespace-normalising before checking produces a "quote" that exists nowhere
rules.rule: Do not whitespace-normalise source text before checking a quote against it.

rules.quote: quote short spans that genuinely hit, or paraphrase
rules.rule: For PDF extractions that break mid-word, quote only short spans that genuinely match the source, or paraphrase.

rules.quote: fetch every cited primary to `work/<run-id>/src-*`
rules.rule: Fetch every cited primary source to work/<run-id>/src-* for the full quote sweep.

rules.quote: substring-test every `evidence[]` quote after Unicode punctuation folding
rules.rule: Substring-test every evidence[] quote against its primary after Unicode punctuation folding.

rules.quote: judge it, never auto-correct
rules.rule: When a page edited after publication makes a quote mismatch, judge the change; never auto-correct the quote.

rules.quote: lift the source record in the same motion
rules.rule: When lifting a sentence from an existing entry, lift its sources[] record in the same edit.

rules.quote: after every fix, grep the same fact across title/headline/summary/body/evidence/cves
rules.rule: After every fix, grep the same fact across title, headline, summary, body, evidence and cves.

rules.quote: Re-derive every numeral and absolute ("every", "all", "first") from the body's own enumeration immediately before commit.
rules.rule: Immediately before commit, re-derive every numeral and absolute (every, all, first) from the body's own enumeration.

rules.quote: One citation per clause
rules.rule: Give each clause one citation.

rules.quote: cite the relay for reach + timing only
rules.rule: When citing a national-CERT relay, use it only for reach and timing, not for the vendor's content.

rules.quote: read the page's own date field
rules.rule: Read a page's own date field to date it; do not infer the date from a URL slug.

rules.quote: re-fetch before re-quoting
rules.rule: Re-fetch a vendor blog URL before re-quoting it, since such URLs change in place.

rules.quote: check which artifact carries the clause
rules.rule: When a source has both a blog and a PDF, check which artifact carries the clause before citing it.

rules.quote: an attribution no fetched source connects is not fixable by adding a plausible link
rules.rule: Drop an attribution that no fetched source connects, rather than adding a plausible link.

rules.quote: fetch and cite that fuller original as primary
rules.rule: When a recap links a fuller original write-up, fetch it and cite it as the primary source.

rules.quote: Re-verify every remediation against the primary in the *same* pass that applies it
rules.rule: Re-verify every remediation against the primary source in the same pass that applies it.

rules.quote: re-read the exact sentence against the source text before moving on
rules.rule: After applying a fix, re-read the exact sentence against the source text before moving on.

rules.quote: the next iteration existing to catch it is not a substitute for checking your own fix
rules.rule: Do not rely on a later verifier iteration to catch a defect in your own fix; check the fix yourself.

rules.quote: Before publish, manually grep every entry for `[.]`/bracket-defanged strings and judge each
rules.rule: Before publishing, manually grep every entry for bracket-defanged strings and judge each one.

rules.quote: attacker-registered C2/staging domains are not, however defanged
rules.rule: Do not name attacker-registered C2 or staging domains, even defanged.

rules.quote: legitimate infrastructure the malware calls (a public relay directory, an impersonated real service) is fine to name
rules.rule: Naming legitimate infrastructure the malware calls, such as a public relay directory or an impersonated real service, is allowed.

rules.quote: triage a `page-revised` quote by reading what the page says NOW, not by patching the quote text
rules.rule: Triage a page-revised quote by reading what the page now says, not by patching the quote text.

rules.quote: re-read the title, summary, `immediate_action`, `actions[]` and the first paragraphs against the new state before moving on
rules.rule: When writing any record, re-read the title, summary, immediate_action, actions[] and first paragraphs against the new state before moving on.

rules.quote: grep the whole file (title, headline, summary, sourcing_note, actions, cves[] status/affected/fixed, main analysis, every section) for present-tense status words
rules.rule: Before the first verifier spawn on an entry whose record changes its state, grep the whole file for present-tense status words.

rules.quote: Date each hit to first publication or bring it to the new state
rules.rule: Date each present-tense status hit to first publication, or update it to the new state.

rules.quote: When an evidence quote is split or translated, the same passage quoted in the body needs the same treatment in the same edit
rules.rule: When an evidence quote is split or translated, apply the same change to the matching body quote in the same edit.

rules.quote: wrap record summaries with `break_on_hyphens=False`
rules.rule: Wrap record summaries with break_on_hyphens=False so hyphenated words do not split across lines.

rules.quote: say in the record that no verifier pass read them
rules.rule: When fixing findings after the iteration cap, state in the record that no verifier pass read them.

rules.quote: Never lower the residual count for them.
rules.rule: Never lower the residual count for findings fixed after the iteration cap.

rules.quote: Frame it as "the advisory as read on <date> says X; press says Y", never as the entry's error
rules.rule: When a relay's wording differs from a vendor page, frame it as what the advisory says on the read date versus what the press says, not as an entry error.

rules.quote: attribute each clause to the source that actually carries it
rules.rule: Attribute each clause to the source that actually carries it.

rules.quote: A page's own revision history is not evidence that it has not changed
rules.rule: Do not treat a page's revision history as evidence that the page has not changed.

rules.quote: when you edit an existing entry, re-check every `evidence[]` quote that stays, not just the new ones
rules.rule: When editing an existing entry, re-check every evidence[] quote that remains, not only the new ones.

rules.quote: read the page's own `datePublished`/`dateModified` (or its case timeline), not the transport header
rules.rule: Before a developing-window or lookback argument rests on a page date, read the page's own datePublished or dateModified, not the reader transport header.

rules.quote: re-fetch the live page, replace every quote the new text no longer carries
rules.rule: When a national-CERT alert is revised, re-fetch the live page and replace every quote the new text no longer carries.

rules.quote: rewrite the title, Detection and takeaway where the guidance moved
rules.rule: When a national-CERT alert's guidance moves, rewrite the title, Detection and takeaway to match.

rules.quote: so state the disagreement in the entry
rules.rule: When a relay keeps quoting an older version of a revised alert, state the disagreement in the entry.

rules.quote: Fix the whole class in the neighbouring clauses in one edit, not the single flagged sentence
rules.rule: When fixing a verifier finding, fix the whole class in the neighbouring clauses in one edit, not only the flagged sentence.

rules.quote: cut the word count elsewhere or correct the note in the same edit
rules.rule: When trimming an entry to fit the word limit, cut words elsewhere or correct any run note that the cut falsifies, in the same edit.

rules.quote: Editing with `text.index(a):text.index(b)` slices is unsafe.
rules.rule: Do not edit file text by slicing between text.index(a) and text.index(b).

rules.quote: Replace short unique phrases with `assert text.count(old) == 1`
rules.rule: When replacing text in a file, use short unique phrases guarded by assert text.count(old) == 1.

rules.quote: `git diff` or reread the file after any bulk Python edit
rules.rule: After any bulk Python edit, check the result with git diff or reread the file.

rules.quote: re-spawn the same iteration with a note that earlier partial files are to be ignored
rules.rule: After a lost verifier spawn, re-spawn the same iteration and tell it to ignore earlier partial files.

rules.quote: Pair verifier findings with dispositions in each findings file's own order, never in the order the verifier's summary message lists them
rules.rule: Pair verifier findings with dispositions in each findings file's own order, not the order of the verifier's summary message.

rules.quote: Count it the same way (strip `[text](url)` to `text`) before writing
rules.rule: Before writing, count the entry body the way the word-cap check does: strip each [text](url) link to its text.

rules.quote: `evidence[].publisher` must equal a `sources[].publisher` string
rules.rule: Make each evidence[].publisher value exactly match a sources[].publisher string.

rules.quote: A living page (vendor statement, tracker, research post updated for days) is ONE `sources[]` record
rules.rule: Record a living page that is updated over several days as one sources[] record.

rules.quote: dated to the date the cited text states and labelled "updated through <date>"
rules.rule: Date a living page's sources[] record to the date the cited text states, labelled updated through that date.

rules.quote: Cite publication or last-updated date consistently inline
rules.rule: Cite the publication or last-updated date consistently inline.

rules.quote: Rewrite the whole note to two or three provenance sentences.
rules.rule: When a verifier re-opens a sourcing note, rewrite the whole note as two or three provenance sentences.

rules.quote: Entry slugs are capped at 60 characters
rules.rule: Keep entry slugs to 60 characters or fewer.

rules.quote: name the file before the first `Write`
rules.rule: Name the file before the first Write of a new entry.

rules.quote: When a fire updates a covered entry, re-read the pages its exploitation claims rest on
rules.rule: When updating a covered entry, re-read the pages its exploitation claims rest on.

rules.quote: grep the live page for every quote of that source across the sibling entries
rules.rule: Grep the live page for every quote of a source across the sibling entries, not only the entries the fire modifies.

rules.quote: A retraction is an `update`
rules.rule: Record a source retraction as an update to the entry.

rules.quote: Run-record frontmatter lists must be indented under their key.
rules.rule: Indent run-record frontmatter lists under their key.

rules.quote: dump with a `SafeDumper` subclass whose `increase_indent` forces `indentless=False`
rules.rule: Dump run-record YAML with a SafeDumper subclass whose increase_indent forces indentless=False.

rules.quote: Add a general product blog as a candidate only with `content_scope: general-news`
rules.rule: Add a general product blog as a candidate only with content_scope set to general-news.

rules.quote: Stamp a changelog record's `at` from `date -u` when you write it; never plan times ahead.
rules.rule: Stamp a changelog record's at field from date -u when writing it; never plan times ahead.

rules.quote: Use `tools/entry_record.py add` (it stamps) or take `date -u` first
rules.rule: Use tools/entry_record.py add, or take date -u first, to stamp a changelog record.

rules.quote: cite the listing page for the count and each per-item page for each per-item clause
rules.rule: Cite the listing page for a count and each per-item page for each per-item clause.

rules.quote: Every added fact on an over-limit entry must be paid for in the same edit
rules.rule: Every fact added to an over-limit entry must be paid for by removal in the same edit.

rules.quote: declare each removal in the record summary as "Removed from the text: ..." without the pipeline's reason
rules.rule: Declare each removal in the record summary as Removed from the text, without the pipeline's reason.

rules.quote: Re-read vendor timelines (Palo Alto JSON, advisory tables) just before the commit
rules.rule: Re-read vendor timelines just before the commit.

rules.quote: update every entry that carries it in one pass
rules.rule: When a fix list changes during a run, update every entry that carries it in one pass.

rules.quote: look for it before citing the landing page
rules.rule: Look for a per-incident permalink before citing a status page's landing page.

rules.quote: so do not switch to it
rules.rule: Do not switch to an anchored URL that answers 403 on every transport.

rules.quote: Do the adversarial wording pass (superlatives, "only", "after", "first", causal order) on every clause the run added before the first spawn
rules.rule: Before the first verifier spawn, check every clause the run added for superlatives, only, after, first and causal order.

rules.quote: Before writing such a summary, search the whole file for the old wording.
rules.rule: Before writing a record summary that says a statement is replaced, search the whole file for the old wording.

rules.quote: the SUG API filter on `latestRevisionDate` is the way to see them
rules.rule: To detect Microsoft revisions, use the SUG API filter on latestRevisionDate.

rules.quote: make the record non-internal with a short section instead
rules.rule: When an internal record would grow past its prose limit, make the record non-internal with a short section instead.

rules.quote: Put a cue word within 80 characters (release, version, fixed, upgrade, build) in every field that carries one
rules.rule: Put a cue word (release, version, fixed, upgrade, build) within 80 characters of any version string in every field that carries one.

rules.quote: When a rewrite re-cites an old source, fetch it.
rules.rule: When a rewrite re-cites an older source, fetch it first.

rules.quote: the container reads github.com only through `WebFetch`
rules.rule: Read github.com pages only through WebFetch.

rules.quote: State both accounts when sources disagree instead of picking the one that fits the headline.
rules.rule: When sources disagree, state both accounts instead of picking the one that fits the headline.

rules.quote: Count with the gate's own `_MD_LINK_TEXT_RE` before the first gate run.
rules.rule: Count words with the gate's own _MD_LINK_TEXT_RE before the first gate run.

rules.quote: `yaml.safe_dump` output fails `run-parse`; shift the nested lists by two spaces
rules.rule: Do not use yaml.safe_dump output for run records; indent nested lists two spaces deeper so run-parse accepts them.

rules.quote: For a CNA record use the CVE record API for reading and GitHub's advisory pages through `WebFetch` for citing.
rules.rule: For a CNA record, read it through the CVE record API and cite GitHub advisory pages fetched through WebFetch.

rules.quote: dump with a Dumper whose `increase_indent` is non-indentless and `width=100000`
rules.rule: When generating a run record from a script, use a Dumper whose increase_indent is non-indentless and whose width is 100000.

rules.quote: a `fetch_failures[]` record for a bridge-allowlisted host needs `bridge:`-prefixed `attempted_methods`
rules.rule: Give a fetch_failures[] record for a bridge-allowlisted host bridge:-prefixed attempted_methods.

rules.quote: `sources[].role` is only `primary` or `corroborating`
rules.rule: Set sources[].role only to primary or corroborating.

rules.quote: `discovered_at` must not lie after the clock
rules.rule: Never set discovered_at to a time after the current clock.

rules.quote: A product named only through `affected_products[]` stays out of `entities[]`
rules.rule: Do not add a product named only through affected_products[] to entities[].

rules.quote: After any cut, re-read the sentence's last citation against the facts it now follows.
rules.rule: After cutting words, re-read the sentence's last citation against the facts it now follows.

rules.quote: Write `discovered_at` from the file's real creation time, never a guessed later minute.
rules.rule: Write discovered_at from the file's real creation time, never a guessed later minute.

rules.quote: `date -u` before each Write fixes it
rules.rule: Run date -u before each Write to get the real timestamp.

rules.quote: write the real clock
rules.rule: Write the run record's completed placeholder with the real clock; Phase 6 re-stamps it.

rules.quote: A new entry's slug must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,59}$` (60 characters at most)
rules.rule: Make each new entry slug match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,59}$.

rules.quote: rename the file and every registry `relations[].source` that names it in the same step
rules.rule: When renaming an entry file, rename every registry relations[].source that names it in the same step.

rules.quote: Do not subtract the previous two fires' attempts from a rotation slice when the cursor already ranks it.
rules.rule: Do not subtract previous fires' attempts from a rotation slice when the cursor already ranks it.

rules.quote: rank on the cursor alone and say so in the run notes
rules.rule: Rank rotation slices on the cursor alone and say so in the run notes.

rules.quote: survives only if the title, headline and summary keep it
rules.rule: Keep a source's hedge in the title, headline and summary as well as the body.

rules.quote: check `runs/*` borderline-drop lines before re-litigating
rules.rule: Check the runs/* borderline-drop lines before re-litigating a re-surfaced lookback item.

rules.quote: A single-quoted YAML scalar needs `''` for every apostrophe you insert
rules.rule: Double every apostrophe inserted into a single-quoted YAML scalar.

rules.quote: After editing a quoted frontmatter field, re-parse with `yaml.safe_load`.
rules.rule: After editing a quoted frontmatter field, re-parse the file with yaml.safe_load.

rules.quote: Internal records may change at most about 12 words of prose
rules.rule: Limit changes to an internal record's prose to about 12 words.

rules.quote: Check a figure caption before accepting "the text does not say so"
rules.rule: Check a figure caption before accepting that the text does not say something.

rules.quote: so a new citation must use that date
rules.rule: When a URL has multiple sources[] records, a new citation on it must use the date of the last record.

rules.quote: Read a relayed bulletin at its origin before writing an update on it.
rules.rule: Read a relayed bulletin at its origin before writing an update on it.

rules.quote: When a new reading supersedes a fact, grep the whole entry for the old fact, including the main analysis, not just the summary and the action you are editing.
rules.rule: When a new reading supersedes a fact, grep the whole entry for the old fact, including the main analysis.

rules.quote: Re-read the vendor's announcement listing for newer builds when you name a fix.
rules.rule: When naming a fix, re-read the vendor's announcement listing for newer builds.

rules.quote: A reboot instruction belongs only to the release the vendor attaches it to.
rules.rule: Include a reboot instruction only for the release the vendor attaches it to.

rules.quote: trim in the same edit
rules.rule: When adding a citation that pushes the main analysis over its word bound, trim words in the same edit.

rules.quote: Public record summaries state the development, never the edit
rules.rule: Write public record summaries to state the development, not the edit.
